blocks.text: Alexandra “Alex” Eala had not won against Tereza Valentova before, so the fact that she finally did it in a crucial stage of the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open was sweet. Eala won in straight sets, 6-4, 7-6, when she faced Valentova on center court on Thursday night, November 5. She will face Antonia Ruzic of Croatia in the quarterfinals. In Hong Kong last year, Eala lost in the round of 16 to Canada’s Victoria Mboko, who eventually won the tournament.
